item_name: Sabre Super Red Pepper Defense Spray
item_short_desc: Sabre Supre Red Pepper Defense Spray is designed for security personnel and law enforcement professionals. Not available for sale in NY, MA, WI, and HI.
description: Sabre Supre Red Pepper Defense Spray is designed for security personnel and law enforcement professionals. The 4oz Magnum 120 Spray offers serious protection with a maximum strength red pepper and can spray up to 8-10 feet. A UV Marking Dye allows for easy identification. The Sabre Supre Red Pepper Spray contains Genuine Oleoresin Capsicum and is Iso 9001 Certified.
